description: Expected result of parsing basic.snapshot.pl with insimul-runtime's prolog-fact-parser.ts (packages/core/src/prolog/prolog-fact-parser.ts). The .pl file is a byte-exact insimul_kb_snapshot() image; this pins that the wrappers' TS fact parser accepts the native snapshot format. Regenerate with: ctest -R snapshot (updates basic.snapshot.pl) then re-run snapshot_parse.
